summary: Klamath Falls City Schools urges the FCC to keep E‑Rate fully funded, oppose any narrowing or sunset, reject a rural‑only restriction, preserve both Category 1 and 2 services, and expand eligibility to include cybersecurity tools. The comment urges the FCC to keep and strengthen the E‑Rate program, emphasizing its essential role for rural schools.
